request_claims: Overlay-0 assembly explicitly loads qwords at vi03 offsets +1,+4,+7,+10 and stores corresponding vf11/vf16/vf21/vf26 records to vi04 offsets +1,+4,+7,+10.
Overlay-1 assembly explicitly loads qwords at vi03 offsets +1,+4,+7,+10 and stores corresponding vf11/vf16/vf21/vf26 back to vi03 at those offsets.

The static access listings and resident overlay byte copies do not prove overlay-0 or overlay-1 executed for race94 car geometry, nor do they identify the source four-byte plane as a rendered normal or color value.

evidence.text: SHA-256 f5ade691d5c7de71be42e79adb5981f6b6441b451dc9ca9a181f1e1bda798fec, overlay-0.s. Lines 131-134: lq vf11,1(vi03), lq vf16,4(vi03), lq vf21,7(vi03), lq vf26,10(vi03). Lines 146-155 show arithmetic on vf10/vf15/vf20/vf25, and matching sq vf11,1(vi04), etc. Line 135 converts vf11.w from vf05.w; other following lines convert vf16/vf21/vf26 w lanes. Full explicit vi03 references are retained in static-trace.json.

SHA-256 b6213e2c175bbb515cd5bbe86da393db65156847ebd233ca48148030acd0486a, overlay-1.s. Lines 33-36 load qwords at vi03+1,+4,+7,+10 into vf11/vf16/vf21/vf26. Lines 66-69 store vf11/vf16/vf21/vf26 back at vi03+1,+4,+7,+10 while separate XY arithmetic affects vf10/vf15/vf20/vf25. Full explicit vi03 references are retained in static-trace.json.

VU1 snapshots contain exact copies of overlays 0..6, but do not record the executing VU PC or link an overlay execution to a captured packet. Source overlay V4-8 writes a four-byte plane at input qword +1, but there is no proven live overlay selection and byte-to-register-to-packet color/normal join.
